title: Print Visualization Library
description: Turn the print product's visualization layer into a full, d3-like static component library in semio style: every visualization component configurable through a documented key-value API, every component covered by a language-agnostic test plus a third-party cross-validation, taxonomy-complete coverage, and zero-touch cross-platform build, test and launch commands.
note: Ticket bookkeeping done manually on disk: repo MCP failed to connect at session start (2026-09-05).
summary: Rebuilt the print visualization layer into semio-viz, a d3-like grammar-of-graphics library in LaTeX3 with a TypeScript twin. 1,966 taxonomy leaves are covered exactly once by 1,738 catalogue chart kinds over 246 registered families in 80 semio-viz packages (kernel: data, transform, scale, format, coordinate, mark, shape, layout with 30 algorithms, guide, annotation, label, facet, composition, plot grammar, theme, probe; namespaces per taxonomy section 76). Every family is option-driven with schema-documented keys in English and German; every kind renders distinctly. 106 language-neutral Gherkin cases (330+ scenarios) run on the repo test platform with 30 third-party oracles (d3 modules, dagre, mathjs, jstat, fft.js, gl-matrix, suncalc, ajv, markdown-it) plus the TypeScript twin as cross-implementation oracle: fundamental 17/17, parity quick 550/550, parity long 630/630, 0 contract breaches. Generated catalogue packages and gallery documents, a 172-page bilingual API reference, README, nx targets and launch entries. Toolchain bootstrapped on Windows (generated layer, bun 1.4.2, tectonic in-process extraction). Exhaustive 320-variant gallery sweep left running (documented); two small follow-ups noted for a separate ticket.
